help.config_b1: 1. Protection engine: select the protection level (Full, Technical & network, or Personal data & GDPR), protected copy suffix, and file input method.
help.config_b2: 2. Window & system: configure what happens when clicking close [X] or minimize [-], the startup tab, and visible navigation tabs.
help.config_b3: 3. Clipboard & alerts: adjust notification style when intercepting text, timed auto-wipe, and the bottom CLI dock.
help.config_b4: 4. Appearance, language & security: choose language, visual theme, accent color, font size, button style, and vault inactivity auto-lock.
help.config_p1: The Settings tab is organized into 4 functional blocks with a top action bar to save, reset, or inspect logs at any time:
help.logs_p1: The log console records every event from the native Rust engine (Tauri calls, vault reads/writes, detections, and transformations). You can enable debug mode for verbose traces or filter by level (INFO, WARN, ERROR).
help.pairs_op1: Add pair: lets you preload custom associations (e.g. your name with a protected value of your choice).
help.pairs_op2: Quick search & clear: filter by original or protected value and click ✕ to clear the search box instantly.
help.pairs_op3: Omit token: if a keyword or technical term should never be replaced, select it and click Omit.
help.pairs_op4: Backups (.bak): automatic backups created when modifying pairs can be restored individually from the Vaults table.
help.pairs_p1: Whenever LexiShield detects or replaces a sensitive token, it creates a bijective mapping in the active vault. This guarantees that the same confidential entity always receives the exact same protected value across all your documents.
help.pwd_h4: Why does LexiShield require a password for its vaults?
help.pwd_p1: LexiShield was engineered to protect enterprise-grade secrets and highly confidential personal data. A password is mandatory for three non-negotiable architectural reasons:
help.pwd_r1: Immunity to physical or forensic attacks: if someone accesses your hard drive, without the master password it is mathematically impossible to reconstruct the link between protected values and real secrets.
help.pwd_r2: Argon2id + ChaCha20-Poly1305 cryptography: the decryption key is never stored in any file; it is derived via memory-hard Argon2id parameters to neutralize GPU and ASIC brute-force attacks.
help.pwd_r3: Strict per-project or per-client isolation: by assigning different passwords to different vaults (.lexi), you guarantee an impenetrable cryptographic wall for each client or environment.
help.sc_audit_text: Audit current text without modifying it
help.sc_clear_panels: Clear both panels (saving snapshot to history)
help.sc_open_help: Open help manual and quick shortcuts
help.sc_protect_restore: Protect or restore data (based on active direction)
help.shortcuts_subtitle: Operate the entire protection and navigation workflow without taking your hands off the keyboard.
help.studio_audit_desc: When dragging or scanning files and folders, the pre-inspection screen opens automatically. LexiShield classifies tokens by Network, Identity, Systems, or Keys, letting you omit false positives before saving them to your vault.
help.studio_h4: How to protect text for AI prompts or data sharing
help.studio_kbd_prompt: Prefer working with the keyboard? Check out the full quick shortcuts reference.
help.studio_p1: The main goal of the Transform view is to let you safely interact with language models (such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or local AIs) or share documents without exposing confidential information (client names, IDs, IBANs, passwords, IP addresses, or payment cards).
help.studio_pandoc_desc: If you enable saving to Markdown with Pandoc, LexiShield converts structured documents (.docx, .html, .rst) into native Markdown (.md), preserving headings, lists, and tables for optimal AI token efficiency.
help.studio_wf1: Paste content into the Clear text panel (or drag and drop a file or folder directly onto it).
help.studio_wf2: Auto detection: the engine automatically identifies the syntactic structure (JSON, XML, logs, or plain text) with zero configuration.
help.studio_wf3: Click Protect: the central directional button replaces every confidential item with a consistent protected value.
help.studio_wf4: Reactive Markdown mode: clicking the Markdown switch in the top bar automatically protects the original text and shows a formatted preview in both panels.
help.studio_wf5: Use the text with AI: copy the Protected text and send it with complete peace of mind to any AI model or third party.
help.studio_wf6: Restore the AI response: when the AI replies citing protected values, paste its reply into Protected text and click Restore to recover 100% of the real values.
help.subtitle: Key concepts, security recommendations, and workflows.
help.title: LexiShield manual & contextual help
help.vaults_backup_desc: The Full backup button packages all your settings and vaults into a single Bzip2-compressed archive (optionally encrypted with AES-256). With Restore backup you can recover any backup archive (.tar.bz2 or .lexibak) completely.
help.vaults_p1: Vaults (.lexi) are hermetic binary files where your tokens and mappings reside. You can create multiple vaults to separate clients, projects, or personal environments.
help.watch_feat1: Top bar control: click Monitor to start listening and Stop to pause it.
help.watch_feat2: Transparent notification: when copying text with no secrets, it reports 0 tokens recognized so you know the text was left untouched.
help.watch_feat3: Immediate preview: history shows in real time both the captured text and the transformed result placed in the clipboard.
help.watch_feat4: Secure wipe: click Clear clipboard in the top bar or schedule automatic wiping after N seconds in Settings.
help.watch_p1: Sentinel mode turns LexiShield into a silent guardian of your clipboard. While you work, whenever you copy confidential text, the system automatically transforms it without needing to switch windows.
